text:
emily: Hey runtime team — prepping the interactive webinar demo (Wed). Need a quick sanity + tail-latency sweep for the quantized variant we plan to show. Focus: cold-start + cache-miss worst-cases and a small randomized stability probe. Can you run a short rerun on dedicated or a reserved slot? :eyes:

tyler_runtime: sure — can you list exact payloads and which model pin we should use? also how long do you need the run to take?

emily: payloads are in s3: s3://marketing-artifacts/webinar/interactive-pack-v3.json (includes 60 short+long prompts + 10 adversarial chains). Pin model to `redwood-instruct-v1-q4_0` (we plan to demo quantized). Need warmup+cold cycles; target total ~10m wall time if possible.

tyler_runtime: got it. two quick asks: 1) do you want rerun with and without prefix/KV cache enabled? 2) should we include fallback-gen to cpu binary for a couple of long-context samples?

emily: yes on both. We want 4 variants: (A) cache on, (B) cache off, (C) cache on + fallback disabled, (D) cache on + fallback enabled. Please record per-token p50/p90/p99 and end-to-end cold-start for first token. Also capture any oom/gpu-fallback events.

sam_ops: if you need Dedicated capacity I can reserve a 15m slot on the analytics pool at 11:30 PT. otherwise bench-bot can squeeze it on shared, but results might be noisy.

emily: if Dedicated is available that'd be ideal. 11:30 PT works. Please annotate run id in the results so marketing can pull artifacts quickly.

tyler_runtime: scheduling on Dedicated 11:30 PT. Command we'll use (adjusted for automation):

```bash
./run_bench --model redwood-instruct-v1-q4_0 \
  --payload s3://marketing-artifacts/webinar/interactive-pack-v3.json \
  --variants cache_on,cache_off,cache_on_no_fallback,cache_on_with_fallback \
  --seed 1234 --warmup 100 --duration 600 \
  --metrics p50,p90,p99,cold_start,oom_events \
  --out s3://redwood-results/marketing/webinar/1712349999/\
```

tyler_runtime: bench-bot will tag the run with `marketing/webinar/interactive-v3` and include a small manifest with sample indices of failing prompts.

bench-bot: Started job 98765 on dedicated-analytics (ETA ~12m) :gear:

ana_sales: Emily — FYI we have 3 enterprise trial signups expected in EMEA. Can we also capture region=eu latency slice so sales can triage lead routing?

emily: yes please include region=us,eu in the run breakdown. tag artifacts with `region=eu` if any metrics cross the 500ms p99 threshold.

tyler_runtime: will add region slice. one more: do you want raw responses saved for a single failing seed per variant? that helps debug hallucination/regression claims for the webinar demo.

emily: save raw responses for up to 5 failing cases total (max). put them under `s3://redwood-results/marketing/webinar/1712349999/raw/`. Thanks!

sam_ops: reserved and pre-warmed the pool. If oom events happen we'll automatically down-quantize to q3 for the fallback variant and log it.

tyler_runtime: run complete — uploading metrics + manifest (upload link: https://s3.console.aws.amazon.com/s3/object/redwood-results/marketing/webinar/1712349999/metrics.json). Quick summary: p99 tail for cache_off spiked to ~820ms on 2 long prompts, 3 OOM->fallback events logged. Raw failures saved.

emily: amazing thank you. can you paste the manifest lines for the 3 OOM events here?

tyler_runtime: manifest snippet: `[{"prompt_idx":12,"variant":"cache_off","event":"oom","fallback":"q3"},{"prompt_idx":47,"variant":"cache_on_no_fallback","event":"oom","fallback":"none"},{"prompt_idx":58,"variant":"cache_off","event":"oom","fallback":"q3"}]`

emily: perfect. tagging @ana_sales to follow up with lead routing for EU trials and @sam_ops for post-run cleanup.

ana_sales: got it — I'll open a lead ticket and attach the metrics snapshot.

sam_ops: cleaning up the reserved slot. bench artifacts retained for 7 days.

emily: this is great — marketing can use the metrics + raw fails for an internal dry-run. Tyler, any concerns before we use numbers in the webinar slides?

tyler_runtime: numbers are valid for the documented config and dedicated pool; callout in slides: "Dedicated reserved slot + warmup=100. Shared returns may vary." Also recommend noting the ran seed and manifest link if you highlight a failing case.

emily: will do. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
